### TOTP secrets — add these to Google Authenticator / Authy

Three roles hold permissions that trigger step-up, so they cannot log in with a password
alone. This is deliberate, not a bug: Owner and Tenant admin hold `rbac.manage`, and the
Accountant holds `finance.period.close` — administering roles and closing an accounting
period both need a second factor.

| Account | Secret (Base32) |

| `admin@terrace.local` | `WGPB246SK2YWJZBGNHUTDGKHMJXUGXLS` |
| `accountant@terrace.local` | `2XPUJEA7F6YYOV4P7ME5OH6PUBJWTV5C` |

## Control Bistro — isolation control (small, deliberate)

**Tenant slug: `control-bistro-isolation-test-tenant`** · Tier **STARTER** · `FEATURE_CRM`
forced **OFF**

Kept on purpose. With one tenant, nothing can distinguish "tenant scoping works" from
"there was only ever one tenant's data to return" — and cross-tenant leakage is the
highest-severity defect class in a multi-tenant system. Its CRM module is disabled so
feature gating is exercised rather than assumed. Log in as any Floating Terrace persona
and try to reach this tenant's data: you should get a 404, never a 403 and never a row.

| Role | Email | Password | TOTP |

## What each role can actually do

Measured at login, not claimed — this is the permission count each account really carries:

| Role | Permissions | The point of it |
|---|---|---|
| OWNER | 65 (all) | Everything, including role administration |
| TENANT_ADMIN | 64 | Everything except `rbac.manage` — administers users and branches through fine-grained codes |
| MANAGER | 49 | Menu, staff, reports; no role administration |
| ACCOUNTANT | 24 | Chart of accounts, journals, period close |
| CASHIER | 14 | Till open/close, settle, void own |
| WAITER | 7 | Take orders, send to kitchen — **no till, no void, no refund** |
| INVENTORY_MANAGER | 5 | Ingredients, stock |
| KITCHEN_STAFF | 2 | KDS view and update only |

## Things that will look like bugs and are not

**A waiter cannot settle a cash payment.** Cash settlement requires the paying user to have
an OPEN till, so a cash tender as the waiter returns `409 NO_OPEN_TILL`. Take the order as
the waiter, then settle as the cashier — that is the designed table-service flow. A card
tender needs no till.

**The Owner cannot log in with only a password.** See TOTP above.

**Control Bistro has no CRM.** Its module is deliberately off.

**Purchasing is empty for Floating Terrace.** The seed reported this honestly rather than
skipping it silently: purchasing answered **403 for the MANAGER**, so no vendor, purchase
order or goods receipt was created. That is a real permission gap being tracked — not
something you did wrong.
